title: Finite torsion-class support for traces over l1 group algebras
exact_target: For every discrete group G and idempotent $e\in M_q(\ell ^{1}(G))$, $q\geq 1$, is there a finite set F of finite-order conjugacy classes such that the diagonal coefficient sum of e over every conjugacy class outside F is zero?
